services.label: Services
services.title: Five ways to move a technical project forward.
services.lead: Depending on where your project stands: from the first brief to taking over code that's become hard to maintain.

ai-ship.label: AI & delivery
ai-ship.title: “Ship it with AI” support
ai-ship.description: You got far with Cursor, v0 or Claude, but going to production or security is the blocker. I take over to finish the job.

product.label: Product journey
product.title: End-to-end product development
product.description: Scoping, development and integrations (payments, third-party APIs, automations), all the way to production.

cto.label: Architecture
cto.title: Part-time tech lead / CTO
cto.description: Stack choices, architecture and technical priorities. If the project grows, I can build and lead a small team.

audit.label: Audit
audit.title: Audit & recovery
audit.description: Project running late or code that's become hard to maintain: an audit, a cleanup and clear recommendations for what's next.

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.title: React Native / Expo apps
mobile.description: From design all the way to the Play Store and TestFlight, certificates, builds and Apple / Google review included.

items.title: Scoping first
items.description: I understand the need before writing code, to avoid needless back-and-forth.

items.title: Clear technical choices
items.description: I propose them, document them, and stay accountable for them all the way to production.

items.title: Clear communication
items.description: Regular progress updates, so you always know where the project stands.

items.title: Maintainable code
items.description: Readable and documented, so another team can pick it up without trouble.

experience.label: Experience
experience.title: Experience.
